# Open SASS Community

> Open SASS gives you everything you need to create, deploy, and scale full-stack applications using Rust and WebAssembly. Developer-friendly tools, production-ready out of the box.

Open SASS is an open-source community and platform for Rust and WebAssembly developers. We provide tools, templates, and resources that enable developers to build full-stack applications with SASS (Software As a Secure Service) architecture using the power of Rust and WASM.

## About

- Website: [https://opensass.org](https://opensass.org)
- Blog index: [https://opensass.org/blogs](https://opensass.org/blogs)
- Sitemap: [https://opensass.org/assets/sitemap.xml](https://opensass.org/assets/sitemap.xml)
- Contact: oss@opensass.org
- GitHub: [https://github.com/opensass](https://github.com/opensass)

## Key Features

- Seamless Integration with WASM Frameworks
- Extensive Template Library
- Customizable Components
- Community-Driven Development
- Comprehensive Documentation
- Collaborative Tools for Teams
